# Draft:Battle of Pofalići (1992)

----
Battle of Pofalići
Battle of Pofalići was a pivotal military engagement fought on May 16, 1992, in the Sarajevo neighborhood of Pofalići. It is widely regarded as one of the most significant early victories for the Territorial Defense of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (TO RBiH) during the Siege of Sarajevo.
TO RBiH victory
| territory   = TO RBiH successfully defends Pofalići
| combatant1  =  Army of Republika Srpska (VRS)
| combatant2  = TO RBiH
| commander1  = Unknown
| commander2  = Sefer Halilović
| strength1   = ~300–400 soldiers with heavy artillery support
| strength2   = ~600+ lightly armed volunteers
| casualties1 = ~100+ killed
| casualties2 = Unknown
| units1      = VRS Vogošća Brigade elements
| units2      = Velešići and Pofalići Detachments
}}
Aftermath and Strategic Impact
The most significant result of the battle was the prevention of the city's partition. Sefer Halilović has frequently emphasized that this victory thwarted the enemy's plan to create a corridor between Vogošća and the "Marshal Tito" barracks. Had this corridor been established, Sarajevo would have been split into two isolated parts, likely leading to the collapse of the city's defense. Instead, the victory secured a vital communication link between the city center and the liberated territories towards the north and west.
The successful defense of Pofalići forced the VRS units to retreat toward the strategic heights of Žuč, which later became the site of further major engagements. Today, 16 May is officially commemorated as the "Day of the Battle of Pofalići" and the Day of the Novo Sarajevo Municipality, marking the moment when the city's territorial integrity was preserved during the most critical stage of the siege.
